FOREST CONSERVATION ORDINANCE
THE Order under Section 3 of the Forest Conservation Ordinance (Chapter 451), as amended by Acts, No. 13 of 1966,No. 56 of 1979, No. 13 of 1982, No. 84 of 1988, No. 23 of 1995 and No. 65 of 2009.
The Order

By virtue of powers vested in me by Section 3 of the Forest Conservation Ordinance (Chapter 451) as amended byActs, No. 13 of 1966, No. 56 of 1979, No. 13 of 1982, No. 84 of 1988, No. 23 of 1995 and No. 65 of 2009, I, Maithripala Sirisena,Minister of Mahaweli Development and Environment do by this order declare the Marekela Forest of 81.903 hectaresbounded by the limit setforth in the schedule hereto as Marakele Reserved Forest form 24th day of July, 2015.
MAITHRIPALA SIRISENA,Minister of Mahaweli Development and Environment.Ministry of Mahaweli Development and Environment,Battaramulla,23rd day of June 2015.
